verdict.rationale: LightSprint's docs say every change runs in a live, shareable preview where anyone can "hop in, watch it build", and a live preview can be opened for any in-progress task, which supports real-time observation of agent output. Current status is only implied through board and ticket state management (tasks move to Done automatically). Agent-captured screenshots and recordings are after-the-fact review rather than live monitoring. Missing for 10: an explicit real-time agent activity or step stream (logs or actions), an explicit per-agent running-status indicator, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
